observations: A large head form tilts at a three-quarter angle against solid black, its upper surface packed with overlapping loops and short scribbled lines in yellow, red, orange, green, blue and pink.
Two eye sockets are built from tight coiled spirals in black, each containing a small grid of yellow and red; a wide-open mouth below shows white teeth and a dark interior.

A second, smaller face appears on the right side of the head — flatter, with blue-white highlights and its own coiled eye — suggesting the form wraps or folds rather than presenting a single frontal view.
reading: The head turns away from a straight-on view, and the dense scribble layer reads as pressure rather than decoration. The coiled eyes hold attention even as the open mouth pulls it downward. A second face folded into the right edge makes the form feel less like a single subject and more like something with more than one side to show.
contextAngle: Within the owned nifty-faces subset, this work sits between title neighbors nnxyz nifty faces #121 and nnxyz nifty faces #123. Both neighbors use coiled-eye forms and exposed teeth, but this is the only one in the owned trio that folds a second face into the same head volume.

connections.reason: nnxyz nifty faces #121 shares the coiled-spiral eye construction and a row of white teeth, but sits on a flat purple ground and faces forward, making the three-quarter fold of #122 a clear contrast.

nnxyz nnotb #134 uses the same black ground and a comparable density of multicolored scribble lines across the upper head, though its face is frontal and the line layer extends beyond the head outline rather than staying within it.

lookingQuestion: Where exactly does the second face begin on the right side of the form, and what lines or shapes mark the boundary between the two faces?
ambiguities: It is unclear whether the right-side face is a separate face or a continuation of the same face seen from a different angle; the image supports both readings.
The nnxyz nnotb #134 comparison is from a different collection series; the formal similarity in line density and black ground is visible, but no other supplied evidence links the two series.

imageReview.method: Original PNG supplied to separate multimodal drafting and review calls
reviewFindings: All three observations confirmed against the primary image: three-quarter angle, coiled spiral eyes with yellow-red grids, open mouth with white teeth, and a smaller right-side face with blue-white highlights and its own coiled eye are all directly visible.
nnxyz nifty faces #121 comparison confirmed: purple flat ground, forward-facing orientation, coiled eyes and white teeth row all visible in that image, making the contrast with #122 concrete.

nnxyz nnotb #134 comparison confirmed: black ground and multicolored scribble lines extending beyond the head outline are visible; frontal orientation contrast with #122 is accurate; ambiguity about cross-series link retained as appropriate.
